models_database.quick_spotter: Maeve has sharp flat track arms; Bellevue has subtle outward flares.
Pinnacle has plush pillow-top arms; Trouper has structured padded arms.
Astor is noticeably taller with three distinct horizontal back cushions.
James features stitched bucket seats; Morrison features smooth continuous seats.
Clayton seat width is noticeably wider (26" inside seat width) for heavy-duty support.
Lauren has pronounced welt trim on rolled arms and boxed cushions.

models_database.recommended_height: Not specified in the tear pad
key_features: Split back cushions for head, neck, and lumbar support
Optional storage console with cup holders
models_database.quick_spotter: Trouper sectional tear pad 2024 (MP0092) documents sculpted bucket seats, split-back cushioning, and modular reclining seating. It does not give ergonomic height guidance or seat capacity.
Finley features clean contemporary track arms without bulky arm padding.
Acadia sits elevated on exposed wood legs even as a power motion sofa.

warranty_rules.lifetime_coverage: Internal furniture frames, springs, and reclining mechanisms: limited lifetime warranty.
warranty_rules.three_year_coverage: Electrical components, motors, and lift mechanisms: 3-year warranty. Contour Cushion foam also has 3-year coverage.
warranty_rules.one_year_coverage: Foam, fabric, leather, battery packs, and labor: 1-year warranty unless a specific upgraded component states otherwise.
